title: Generalize Icon Union For All Canvases
description: Introduce one canonical structured Icon discriminated union (url, shortcode, data image, emoji, typst, text, plus inline svg / catalog) shared across TS and Rust, with a bidirectional string codec for the WASM wire form, and refactor every canvas, the UI chrome, the icon editor, and the semio domain to resolve icons through it — keeping puzzle 2d behavior identical.
